comments.author: @Ibrahim-rx6pm
comments.text: Fascinating and not nitpicking about the history but I heard previously it was his treacherous nobles, the boyers who furnished the horrifying spectacle that greeted the Sultan. If not I'd like to know how he had that many captives? Vlad was fighting much larger armies. Still great, not hating.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: That's a fair historical nuance - some accounts do credit the boyars with supplying part of the grim spectacle rather than Vlad alone, and the sheer scale of the display has long been debated by historians given how it would've required either a massive captive population or exaggeration in the original accounts. Worth taking with a grain of salt either way, given how much of Vlad's reputation comes from hostile contemporary sources.
